lxc_560ff017f353445b.text: Cakes can look and taste very different.

lxc_e16b3e3ac35994b2.text: They all begin with simple ingredients and careful steps.

lxc_334efcbe154e370d.text: First, mix flour, sugar, eggs, and butter in a bowl.

lxc_125d2c8ac5fcbedd.text: Baking powder can help the cake rise, or get bigger.

lxc_642e028102867aba.text: Put the mixture in a cake pan and bake it in an oven.

lxc_d292d8a480b1e7bd.text: After baking, let the cake cool, so it is not hot.

lxc_7a72e197256f7e0e.text: Then you can add cream, fruit, jam, or icing.

lxc_39804c1e8e845357.text: People often eat cake at birthdays and weddings.

lxc_ad820d775db909b0.text: Victoria sponge comes from Britain, or the United Kingdom.

lxc_c370f20ba16f6c07.text: It was named after Queen Victoria.

lxc_ceceaf6f49293dd0.text: The cake has two soft sponge layers.

lxc_1557864fbe3e3002.text: Jam goes between them, like a sandwich.

lxc_bbf6d6286d0d5f9e.text: Many modern cakes also have cream inside.

lxc_692d2268680cbfca.text: The top is usually simple, with a little powdered sugar.

lxc_8429fe40b0e8d7b5.text: Baking powder helps this buttery cake rise and become light.

lxc_d02134292b86e72e.text: Black Forest cake is a German layer cake.

lxc_c66274d103e8f523.text: Its cake layers contain cocoa, so they are dark and taste of chocolate.

lxc_1dba02c89f943253.text: Cherries and whipped cream go between the layers.

lxc_41743fd76c9f298d.text: More cream, cherries, and chocolate can decorate the top.

lxc_e7270e56dff48a9e.text: A written recipe from 1927 is kept in Radolfzell, Germany.

lxc_6d2339919b22aa1c.text: Today, people can find this cake in cafes around the world.

lxc_cb8608787249e86a.text: In the United States, strawberry shortcake has strawberries and cream with a biscuit-like shortcake or sponge cake.

lxc_68094859763e9741.text: It is often a summer dessert.

lxc_a08aafedc91fc7a0.text: In Japan, the cake usually has light sponge layers, whipped cream, and fresh strawberries.

lxc_d386c3f7b1a3ae42.text: Fujiya introduced this style there in 1922.

lxc_5a570a728589ce94.text: It later became a popular Christmas cake.

lxc_1e25795321930b4b.text: The two styles share strawberries and cream, but their cake bases can be different.

lxc_cbe3993d76c45519.text: Tres leches is a Latin American cake that is very popular in Mexico.

lxc_36088261fa50a0f3.text: Bakers soak a light sponge cake in evaporated milk, condensed milk, and whole milk.

lxc_d6cdc1c2a6d30199.text: Small air bubbles in the sponge hold the milk, so the cake stays soft without becoming a wet mess.

lxc_7353bf3299a86177.text: Whipped cream often goes on top, with fruit or cinnamon.
